pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: Name or pattern of headers to remove. The pattern is matched in the following order, 1 = exact match 2 = wildcard (pattern ends with a and the name starts with the pattern) 3 = regular expression (all of above is case in-sensitive).

excludePattern.title: Exclusion Pattern
excludePattern.description: Name or pattern of headers to not remove. The pattern is matched in the following order, 1 = exact match 2 = wildcard (pattern ends with a and the name starts with the pattern) 3 = regular expression (all of above is case in-sensitive).
